questions.markdown:
Identify the correct restriction on static methods:

A. They must access only static data  
B. They can only call other static methods.  
C. They cannot refer to this or super.  
D. They can refer to this or super.  
E. They can call all other methods present in the class to which it belongs to.  

(0.5)

1. A,B,D,E
2. A,B,D
3. A, B
4. **A,B,C

Consider the following interface definition:

```java
interface Base
{
    boolean m1 ();
    byte m2(short s);
}
```

which one of the given code fragment will compile without error(s)?

(0.5)

1.
```java
abstract class Class2 implements Base
{ public boolean m1(){ return (7 > 4); }}
```

2.
```java
interface Base2 implements Base {}
```

3.
```java
abstract class Class2 extends Base
{  public boolean m1(){ return true; }}
```

4.
```java
abstract class Class2 implements Base
{ protected boolean m1(){ return (5 > 7) }}
```
